description: This file defines an abstract test class 'WithMockServers' that manages lifecycle of mock servers used in testing. It includes an annotation for cleanup after all tests and references to test constants for starting and stopping mock servers.

classes.name: WithMockServers
classes.description: An abstract class providing setup and teardown for mock server testing, using JUnit's @AfterClass annotation.

methods.name: stopMockServers
methods.description: A static method annotated with @AfterClass that stops all mock servers used in the tests by calling TestConstants.stopMockServers().
